senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. preced.) [ripe, warm, sweet, well-looking; v. Freitag Arab. Dict. s. v. bšr, a. cmp. לֶחֶם] body (b. h.); flesh, meat.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 8:1">Ḥull. VIII, 1</cite> <he>כל הב׳</he> any kind of meat.
<cite ref="Chullin 16b:15">Ib. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>בְּשַׂר תאוה</he> meat eaten for satisfying the appetite, i.e. secular meal of meat, opp. to sacrificial meals (v.
Deut. XII, 20). Ib. 17ᵃ, v. נְחִירָה; a. fr.—ב׳ ודם (abbr. ב״וד) flesh and blood, i.e. mortal man.
